metadataRaw.title: How to Fix a Popping Ankle FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of ankle clicking, popping, and cracking sounds.

To make it easy, this video will be broken up into separate parts to target the main causes of ankle popping.

To get the best results, go through all exercises and use what works best for you. As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give results within 30 seconds.

Watch now and quickly fix a popping ankle!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:35 Tightness Release
3:49 Strengthening Exercise 1
5:54 Strengthening Exercise 2
8:34 Stretching Exercise
